title: Corruption is in gov't DNA -- Sara Duterte
summary: Corruption is in the government"s DNA Vice President Sara Duterte said in a social media post on Wednesday.

blocks.text: Corruption is in the government’s DNA Vice President Sara Duterte said in a social media post on Wednesday.

In a Facebook post showing her attendance at the 52nd Philippine Business Conference and Expo ng Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) in October, Duterte said that Filipinos dream of a better future.
“Ngunit, malaking hamon sa pangarap na ito ang korapsyon na humahadlang sa atin sa pag-abot ng mas maraming oportunidad at sa kaunlaran,” Duterte said in the social media post.
(However, a big challenge to this dream is the corruption that blocks us from reaching more opportunities and progress.)
“It is a progressive disorder that has embedded itself deep within the DNA of the government—and tragically, it is the Filipino people who are left to suffer the consequences,” she added.
Duterte said as citizens, people should help each other reach that dream, adding that everyone had individual responsibilities.

“As citizens, we have responsibilities, too— to obey the law, reject corruption, protect our communities, participate in our democracy, and demand accountability from those who govern. Nation-building is a shared responsibility,” she said.

Duterte is currently the subject of an impeachment trial where she stands accused of having P817 million to P1.5 billion in unexplained wealth. She also allegedly failed to divest from businesses and did not declare her assets.

She and her defense team have denied all the charges against her. The Vice President has repeatedly cried foul on the corruption allegations, accusing the administration of political persecution. —Jean Mangaluz/RF, GMA News
